ticker_news.title: ACT-ion announces Anthony Thurston as Chief Operating Officer
ticker_news.description: ACTion Battery Technologies, Inc. (ACT-ion) has appointed Anthony Thurston as its new Chief Operating Officer. Thurston has extensive experience in leading cathode active materials (CAM) manufacturing operations at companies like Tesla, BASF, and Apple. The move comes as ACT-ion accelerates the commercialization of its innovative CAM production process.

ticker_news.title: Dawn Project Safety tests reveal that Tesla Full Self-Driving illegally overtakes stopped school buses and runs down children crossing the road
ticker_news.description: The Dawn Project's safety tests reveal that Tesla's Full Self-Driving software illegally overtakes stopped school buses and runs down children crossing the road, posing a critical safety risk. The organization has been warning Tesla about this issue for over two years, but the company has failed to address it.
